primary_uncertainty_method: 10,000-replicate percentile bootstrap resampling source covers; section 7 specifies cover as the statistical unit.

N200_macro_Wilson_diagnostic.note: This message-averaged Wilson diagnostic treats a rounded mean as a binomial count; it is not the cover-cluster interval used for the primary G-Q4 decision.

contrast_uncertainty.interpretation: Independent cluster bootstrap on each corpus; paired replicate indices are not observations paired across corpora.

limitations: C clustered lower bounds pass narrowly; individual message success varies, with minima 0.855 (JPEG) and 0.820 (noise).
Independent-corpus bootstrap intervals for F−C include differences above 0.05 even though point gaps are below 0.05.
The result applies to the frozen BOWS2-C and BOSSBase-F samples and selected configuration; it does not establish transfer to other datasets or parameter settings.
